WITH next_item AS (
    SELECT
        o.id_sync
    FROM helpdesk.ticket_sync_outbox o
    JOIN helpdesk.fact_ticket f
        ON f.id_ticket = o.id_ticket
    WHERE o.status = 'PENDING'
      AND o.operation = 'CREATE_TICKET'
      AND o.target_system = 'SHAREPOINT'

      -- Solo tickets generados desde CORAJE / portal cliente.
      AND f.origen_sistema = 'PORTAL_CLIENTE'

      -- Solo tickets ya redirigidos.
      AND f.id_area_destino IS NOT NULL
      AND f.id_tipo_req IS NOT NULL

      -- No reenviar tickets que ya tengan ítem SharePoint.
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM helpdesk.ticket_legacy_sharepoint_ref r
          WHERE r.id_ticket = f.id_ticket
            AND r.sp_id IS NOT NULL
      )

    ORDER BY o.created_at ASC
    LIMIT 1
    FOR UPDATE OF o SKIP LOCKED
),
claimed AS (
    UPDATE helpdesk.ticket_sync_outbox o
    SET
        status = 'PROCESSING',
        attempts = attempts + 1,
        updated_at = NOW()
    FROM next_item n
    WHERE o.id_sync = n.id_sync
    RETURNING
        o.id_sync,
        o.id_ticket,
        o.operation,
        o.status,
        o.attempts
)
SELECT *
FROM claimed;

SELECT
    o.id_sync,
    o.id_ticket,

    f.codigo_ticket,
    f.descripcion_problema,
    f.fecha_creacion,
    f.fecha_limite,
    f.encargado_interno,
    f.origen_sistema,

    c.nombre_cliente,
    c.identificacion_fiscal,

    a.nombre_area,

    tr.tipo_requerimiento,
    tr.categoria_1,
    tr.categoria_2,

    e.nombre_estado,

    p.nombre_prioridad,
    p.dias_sla

FROM helpdesk.ticket_sync_outbox o
JOIN helpdesk.fact_ticket f
    ON f.id_ticket = o.id_ticket
JOIN core.dim_cliente_contai c
    ON c.id_cliente_contai = f.id_cliente_contai
JOIN core.dim_area a
    ON a.id_area = f.id_area_destino
JOIN helpdesk.dim_tipo_requerimiento tr
    ON tr.id_tipo_req = f.id_tipo_req
JOIN helpdesk.dim_estado e
    ON e.id_estado = f.id_estado
LEFT JOIN helpdesk.dim_prioridad p
    ON p.id_prioridad = f.id_prioridad
LEFT JOIN helpdesk.ticket_legacy_sharepoint_ref r
    ON r.id_ticket = f.id_ticket
WHERE o.id_sync = '{{ $json.id_sync }}'::uuid
  AND o.status = 'PROCESSING'
  AND o.operation = 'CREATE_TICKET'
  AND f.origen_sistema = 'PORTAL_CLIENTE'
  AND f.id_area_destino IS NOT NULL
  AND f.id_tipo_req IS NOT NULL
  AND r.sp_id IS NULL;

WITH ref_upsert AS (
    INSERT INTO helpdesk.ticket_legacy_sharepoint_ref (
        id_ticket,
        sp_id,
        legacy_id_req,
        legacy_title,
        legacy_created_at,
        created_at,
        updated_at
    )
    VALUES (
        '{{ $("Code - Map SharePoint Fields").item.json.id_ticket }}'::uuid,
        {{ $json.sp_id }},
        '{{ $("Code - Map SharePoint Fields").item.json.sharepoint.Id_Req }}',
        '{{ $("Code - Map SharePoint Fields").item.json.sharepoint.Title }}',
        NOW(),
        NOW(),
        NOW()
    )
    ON CONFLICT (id_ticket)
    DO UPDATE SET
        sp_id = EXCLUDED.sp_id,
        legacy_id_req = EXCLUDED.legacy_id_req,
        legacy_title = EXCLUDED.legacy_title,
        legacy_created_at = EXCLUDED.legacy_created_at,
        updated_at = NOW()
    RETURNING id_ticket
)
UPDATE helpdesk.ticket_sync_outbox
SET
    status = 'SENT',
    processed_at = NOW(),
    updated_at = NOW(),
    last_error = NULL
WHERE id_sync = '{{ $("Code - Map SharePoint Fields").item.json.id_sync }}'::uuid
RETURNING
    id_sync,
    id_ticket,
    status,
    processed_at;

UPDATE helpdesk.ticket_sync_outbox
SET
    status = 'FAILED',
    last_error = LEFT(
        COALESCE(
            '{{ $json.error.message }}',
            '{{ $json.message }}',
            '{{ $json.error }}',
            'Error desconocido al crear ítem en SharePoint'
        ),
        2000
    ),
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id_sync = '{{ $("Code - Map SharePoint Fields").item.json.id_sync }}'::uuid
RETURNING
    id_sync,
    id_ticket,
    status,
    last_error;

WITH requeued AS (
    UPDATE helpdesk.ticket_sync_outbox o
    SET
        status = 'PENDING',
        updated_at = NOW(),
        last_error = COALESCE(
            NULLIF(o.last_error, ''),
            'Requeue automático: PROCESSING vencido sin sp_id.'
        )
    WHERE o.status = 'PROCESSING'
      AND o.operation = 'CREATE_TICKET'
      AND o.target_system = 'SHAREPOINT'
      AND o.updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM helpdesk.ticket_legacy_sharepoint_ref r
          WHERE r.id_ticket = o.id_ticket
            AND r.sp_id IS NOT NULL
      )
    RETURNING o.id_sync
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*)::int AS requeued_count
FROM requeued;
